dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Yep, that's a name that reeks of Rouge. Like a swordsman's.

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: That Tiger-Striped Cat is really something! Ah, when those enemies chased us all the way to Poisson...

dialogues.speaker: Freeman
dialogues.text: Jumping out like some kind of great hero, scratching their faces to ribbons! Haha, such a brave, loyal cat.
